name: Execute
description: Deals true damage equal to 16% of nearby enemy heroes lost Health; finishing blow reduces remaining cooldown by 90%

name: Flash
description: Teleports the hero a short distance in the chosen direction

name: Frenzy
description: For 7 seconds increases damage 10%, Resistance 15%, Physical Lifesteal 20%, and Magical Lifesteal 30%

name: Heal
description: Restores 15% Health to user and nearby teammates; grants nearby teammates 15% Movement Speed for 2 seconds

name: Intimidate
description: For 4 seconds reduces nearby enemies damage output 25% and increases user damage reduction 20%

name: Purify
description: Removes debuffs and crowd control except suppression; grants crowd-control immunity for 1.5 seconds

name: Smite
description: Deals 1500 true damage to a nearby monster or minion and stuns it for 1 second

name: Sprint
description: Removes slows and grants 30% Movement Speed for 10 seconds; incoming slows halved

name: Stun
description: Stuns nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds and slows them for 1 second

name: Teleport
description: After a 2-second channel teleports next to an allied structure or minion
